title: Sections comparison commutes with extension by zero
statement: Let f:Y→X be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], J and J′ arbitrary nonnegative cochain complexes of abelian etale sheaves on X and Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and φ:f*J→J′ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Extend φ by zero and precompose with mapExtendIso to define ψ:f*(extend J)→extend J′ using the explicit maps of [lem-weil-pbc-row-integer-sections]. Let b_N and b_Z be the sections-unit comparison maps on the nonnegative and integer-indexed complexes [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison]. Then mapExtendIso(J,Γ_X).inv;b_Z = extendMap(b_N);mapExtendIso(J′,Γ_Y).inv as chain maps. No augmentation, injectivity or cohomology hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 06XR, 01F8 (equations 01F9/01FA), 08J6, and the row comparison of Tags 015J/015K

proof.text: Test equality degreewise. For degree n≥0, express n as the image of a natural number. Unfold mapExtendIso, use mapExtendX_hom_eq and extendMap_f, and normalize the equality transports; both sides become the sections-unit component followed by Γ_Y(φ^n).
For a degree outside the image of the embedding, the extended sections source is zero by isZero_extend_X. Both morphisms are therefore equal.

theorem ceRowSectionsMap_extend {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    {J : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℕ}
    {J' : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℕ}
    (φ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J ⟶ J') :
    (J.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
        (Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).inv ≫
        ceIntegerSectionsMap f (ceExtendedRowMap f φ) =
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (ceSectionsUnit f) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).app J ≫
          ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map φ)
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat ≫
      (J'.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
        (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).inv
